event_summary: A tabletop Newton-cradle-like set of suspended metal balls swings, with a left ball and right-side ball or pair alternately separating from and returning to the central group.
raw_event_description: At the start, a shiny metal frame on a black base holds several suspended reflective balls; one ball is separated toward the left while four balls are close together near the center-right. After a long still interval, the left separated ball moves rightward into the line of balls. A right-side ball or pair then moves outward to the right and returns. The motion repeats several times, alternating between left-side separation and right-side separation, while the frame, base, table, and blue-and-black handled object remain stationary.

reasons: The suspended balls, frame, base, table, and left-side handled object are visible.
The main swinging motion has not yet begun in the first frame.

evidence_bank.observation: A shiny rectangular metal frame stands on a glossy black base on a wooden tabletop.
Several reflective silver balls hang from thin lines inside the frame.
One suspended ball is separated toward the left while four balls are close together near the center-right.
A blue-and-black handled object is partially visible on the table to the left of the base.
The left separated ball moves rightward toward the close group of balls.
The left ball reaches the line of the grouped balls at about the same height.
A right-side ball or pair separates to the right while several balls remain near the center.
The right-side separated ball or pair appears at a rightmost position near the right support post.
The right-side separated ball or pair moves leftward back toward the center group.
A left-side ball separates leftward from the central group after the right-side return.
The alternating left-side and right-side separations repeat several times.
The suspended balls remain attached to their lines.
No visible damage or detachment occurs to the balls, frame, or base.
The frame, base, tabletop, and blue-and-black handled object remain in the same visible positions.
The camera view remains fixed with no visible cut.
